program: Wingless external raw-input to representation to prediction
question: Does Wingless's existing bounded raw-byte motif mechanism learn predictive structure from genuinely external UTF-8/code/JSON bytes and transfer any of that structure across domains without tokenization or external models?
hypothesis: Using only the first 60% of each pinned external source for pooled training, the unchanged 256-entry four-byte motif layer will cover at least 0.03 of each source's heldout final 40%, improve motif-covered top-1 next-byte accuracy by at least 0.05 on every source, reduce effective event count by at least 0.02 on every source, and worsen heldout bits-per-byte by no more than 0.05. In leave-one-domain-out transfer, mean motif-covered accuracy gain will be nonnegative, minimum coverage will be at least 0.005, and maximum adaptive-minus-baseline bits-per-byte will be at most 0.10.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host must be distinct from LINKDEADKB

split.rule: for each exact source byte array, training is bytes [0:floor(0.60*N)] and heldout evaluation is bytes [floor(0.60*N):N]
split.file_boundary_policy: reset all byte context/window state at source boundaries
split.contamination: no heldout byte may enter model construction, motif scoring, smoothing counts, threshold selection, or capacity selection

learner.reuse: byte-for-byte reuse of WLM-LM-REAL-UTF8-BYTE-PILOT-R2 baseline, four-byte motif candidate/filter/score, 256 motif capacity, Jeffreys smoothing, adaptive prediction, and event-reduction metric
learner.motif_score: best-successor count descending, then consistency descending, then lexicographic raw four-byte key

arms.pooled_within_domain: train one model on first-60% segments from all three sources; evaluate each source's final 40% separately
arms.leave_one_domain_out: for each heldout domain, train on first-60% segments of the other two sources only; evaluate final 40% of the heldout source

validity_criteria: Exact parent, North Star, ckb-plane authority lineage, manifest identity, source SHA-256 values, and source byte counts match.
Execution occurs only on GitHub-hosted compute after ckb-plane READY_RESEARCH for this exact preregistration SHA.
All three sources are fetched directly from the frozen manifest URIs and verified before use.
The split is byte-index based with exactly 60% train prefix and 40% heldout suffix per source.
No heldout bytes enter training for the pooled arm; the heldout domain contributes no bytes at all to its leave-one-domain-out training arm.
The existing R2 learner semantics and capacity are reused without tuning.
Raw bytes are consumed exactly; no decoding, tokenization, normalization, lowercasing, whitespace canonicalization, or inserted boundary tokens.
No external model calls, persistent corpus storage, capacity growth, production authority, or LINKDEADKB execution occurs.
The complete run is deterministic and all metrics are finite.

classification_rules.supported: All validity criteria and all frozen pooled and cross-domain thresholds pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and pooled within-domain thresholds pass, but at least one cross-domain transfer threshold fails.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but the pooled external-byte mechanism fails at least one core coverage, accuracy-gain, event-reduction, or bits-per-byte threshold.
classification_rules.incomplete: Authority, network, source retrieval, or compute interruption prevents the frozen matrix.
classification_rules.invalid: Any authority, source identity, split, contamination, learner drift, tokenizer, host-isolation, capacity, or determinism criterion fails.

no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter sources, source identities, byte split, learner, capacity, smoothing, metrics, thresholds, authority requirements, or classification after any primary output.
